fields.title: Google Maps review record
fields.description: Dataset envelope (_input / _source / _scrapedAt / recordType) on top of Google's own review payload. A run emits one PLACE row per input carrying the aggregated sentiment summary, one REVIEW row per review, plus SKIPPED or ERROR rows when an input is filtered out or fails. Split a mixed run by recordType. Google adds and removes fields without notice, so unlisted fields pass through rather than failing the run.

_input.title: Input
_input.description: The exact URL or identifier you supplied that produced this record.

_source.title: Source strategy
_source.description: S1-getlocalboqproxy, or none on failure rows.

_scrapedAt.title: Scraped at
_scrapedAt.description: UTC ISO 8601 timestamp when this record was emitted.

_error.title: Error
_error.description: Failure rows only: unresolvable_input, blocked, or schema_changed.

_warning.title: Warning
_warning.description: Non-fatal marker on SKIPPED rows, e.g. outside_geo_filter or no_coordinates_for_geo_filter.

featureId.title: Feature ID
featureId.description: Google's internal place identifier, 0x...:0x... The second half is the CID in hex.

placeId.title: Place ID
placeId.description: Google Place ID (ChIJ...) when the input supplied one.

cid.title: CID
cid.description: Decimal customer ID, derived from the feature ID.

placeName.title: Place name
placeName.description: Place name taken from the /maps/place/<Name>/ segment of the URL you supplied. Google's resolver itself returns no name, so this is null when you supply a bare Place ID, CID or feature ID.

latitude.title: Latitude
latitude.description: Latitude parsed from the supplied Maps URL (!3d or @lat,lng). Null when the URL carried no coordinates -- Google's resolver returns a default world viewport, not the place's own point.

longitude.title: Longitude
longitude.description: Parsed from the supplied Maps URL.

mapsUrl.title: Maps URL
mapsUrl.description: Canonical Google Maps URL rebuilt from the feature ID.

resolvedVia.title: Resolved via
resolvedVia.description: How the identifier was resolved: input-feature-id, url-feature-id, resolver-place-id, or cid-derived (a CID needs no lookup).

reviewId.title: Review ID
reviewId.description: Stable Google review identifier, used for de-duplication across pages.

text.title: Review text
text.description: Review body in its original language. Null for rating-only reviews.

textTranslated.title: Translated text
textTranslated.description: Google's translation into the requested language, when it supplies one.

language.title: Language
language.description: Detected language code of the original review text.

targetLanguageName.title: Target language name
targetLanguageName.description: Human-readable language the translation is in.

publishedAt.title: Published at
publishedAt.description: Absolute UTC publish time, converted from Google's epoch milliseconds.

publishedAtTimestamp.title: Published at (epoch ms)
publishedAtTimestamp.description: Raw epoch-millisecond timestamp as Google returns it.

relativeTime.title: Relative time
relativeTime.description: Google's own wording, e.g. '2 months ago'.

reviewer.title: Reviewer
reviewer.description: name, avatarUrl, profileUrl, totalReviews, totalPhotos, isLocalGuide.

likesCount.title: Likes
likesCount.description: Thumbs-up count the Maps UI shows on the review (reaction category 3).

reactionCounts.title: Reaction counts
reactionCounts.description: Full per-category reaction breakdown, keyed by Google's category number.

ownerResponse.title: Owner response
ownerResponse.description: The business reply: text, relativeTime, reportUrl. Null when the owner has not replied.

photos.title: Photos
photos.description: Photos attached to the review: url, id, aspectRatio.

attributes.title: Structured attributes
attributes.description: Google's structured prompts answered by the reviewer, e.g. 'When did you visit?' -> 'Weekday'.

visitedText.title: Visited
visitedText.description: Google's visit wording, e.g. 'Visited in June'.

permalink.title: Permalink
permalink.description: Direct Google Maps link to this single review.

reportUrl.title: Report URL
reportUrl.description: Google's report-this-review link for the review.

sourcePlatform.title: Source platform
sourcePlatform.description: Platform the review originated on, normally Google.

sentiment.title: Sentiment
sentiment.description: label (positive/neutral/negative), score (-1..1), method (text+rating, translated+rating, rating-only or none), textScore, ratingScore, language, and ratingTextConflict - true when a confident text polarity contradicted an extreme star rating, which is how sarcastic and mixed reviews surface.

reviewsAnalysed.title: Reviews analysed
reviewsAnalysed.description: PLACE rows: how many reviews the summary covers.

sentimentCounts.title: Sentiment counts
sentimentCounts.description: PLACE rows: review counts per sentiment label.

sentimentPercent.title: Sentiment percentages
sentimentPercent.description: PLACE rows: share of reviews per sentiment label.

averageSentimentScore.title: Average sentiment score
averageSentimentScore.description: PLACE rows: mean blended sentiment score across the analysed reviews.

averageRating.title: Average rating
averageRating.description: PLACE rows: mean star rating across the analysed reviews (not Google's lifetime average).

ratingHistogram.title: Rating histogram
ratingHistogram.description: PLACE rows: review counts keyed by star rating 1-5.

reviewsWithText.title: Reviews with text
reviewsWithText.description: PLACE rows: how many analysed reviews carry a written body.

reviewsWithOwnerResponse.title: Reviews with owner response
reviewsWithOwnerResponse.description: PLACE rows: how many analysed reviews the business replied to.

ownerResponseRatePercent.title: Owner response rate
ownerResponseRatePercent.description: PLACE rows: percentage of analysed reviews that received a reply.

reviewsWithPhotos.title: Reviews with photos
reviewsWithPhotos.description: PLACE rows: how many analysed reviews include photos.

totalLikes.title: Total likes
totalLikes.description: PLACE rows: sum of like counts across the analysed reviews.

ratingTextConflicts.title: Rating/text conflicts
ratingTextConflicts.description: PLACE rows: how many analysed reviews had review text whose tone contradicted the star rating. A high count is a useful signal of sarcastic or mixed feedback.

overview.title: Overview
overview.description: Key columns across every record type this actor emits.

reviews.title: Reviews
reviews.description: One row per review: rating, text, sentiment, likes and the owner's reply.

places.title: Place summaries
places.description: One row per place: aggregated sentiment, rating spread and owner-response rate.
